text:
The skills-and-roles map proposal is clear. `node Server/text-check.mjs` found nothing to fix. The title, the three numbered deliverables and the short paragraphs read in about ten seconds.

I logged one "clear" line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`. I didn't shoot any pages, because this target is a requirements file and has no `page.js`.

I rewrote the outcome of `skills-roles-map`, the one thing that failed the check. It reported the work but didn't list the owner's three asks as `- [x]` with proof beside each.

The new outcome ticks each ask with a link:
- **Table:** 35 skills and 20 roles, with 7-day, 30-day and last-used counts and the log each count came from.
- **Proposals:** the retire, merge and record-only table, in the "Proposals" section of the same doc.
- **Link and script:** the roles readme links the doc (line 44), and `Servex/doc/skills-and-roles.mjs` reruns the table.

No agent owns the task any more, so I applied the rewrite myself. I appended one `assign` line to the task's `session.jsonl` and logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`.

The text-check was clean and the landing named no site pages, so there was no page to screenshot. I checked the roles-readme link and the doc's section headings, but not the doc's counts.
